## Description

Scope after the 6 Nov 2026 design: this ticket is the tenant catalogue, 'New tenant' sales-led onboarding (organisation, country fixes the region, owner invite, start with 30-day pilot or invoice, features on) and tenant detail with feature overrides and audited support access. The console shell, rollouts, plans, billing, licence checks, releases, legal, support, analytics and data requests are MDV-P5-040 to P5-049.
Ops console (separate app/role, no PHI in the control plane): tenant list per country with plan, status, flags; onboarding automation (create tenant, seed config, invite owner); support access requests that the clinic approves, time-boxed (e.g. 2 h), scoped, fully audited and visible to the clinic in its access log.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Support staff cannot see tenant data without an approved, time-limited grant; access ends automatically.
- [ ] **AC2.** Every support action is audited and listed in the clinic's access log (F-12).
- [ ] **AC3.** Flags can be toggled per tenant from the console with audit.
- [ ] **AC4.** The control plane stores no PHI (data map updated).

## Notes / open questions

- Organisation onboarding requests are reviewed in the approval queue (MDV-P5-044); "New tenant" sales-led onboarding creates an already Approved organisation (ADR-016 (docs/adr/ADR-016-organisation-onboarding-and-approval.md, owner decision 10 Nov 2026)).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
